focus: Vietnamese tax-benefit surface: seven-band PIT, social insurance contributions, VAT and special sales tax, the environmental protection tax on fuels, and social assistance under Decree 20/2021 as amended.
purpose: Household-level comparison-oracle and supporting-source references for Viet Nam Axiom coverage. None of these are legal authority.
oracle_scope: A RuleSpec oracle must be an executable, pinned external calculator that accepts household-level inputs and returns household-level tax-benefit outputs comparable to Axiom outputs. Aggregate simulators, distributional reports, parameter documentation, and public model summaries are supporting references only, not oracles.

oracles.name: VNMOD
oracles.dataset: VHLSS-based input microdata (shipped with the licensed bundle where included)
oracles.role: Household-level tax-benefit comparison oracle for Viet Nam. Policy years 2013-24. Report CR-VNMOD-v3.5 (UNU-WIDER).

availability_check.detail: The locally held licensed SOUTHMOD bundle (EUROMOD runtime proven on the Ghana and Rwanda lanes) must be inventoried for VNMOD VN systems before wiring. Validation frame: VNMOD v3.5, policy years 2013-24.
